notes: CAPP18T haloscope run 2 (2021), scan 4.8077-4.8181 GHz corresponding to axion mass 19.883-19.926 ueV. No axion signal found; 90% credibility level (Bayesian) upper bound quoted as ~0.7x|g_KSVZ| (~1.9x|g_DFSZ|) assuming boosted Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution and local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (100% axions). No numerical table of limits provided; the two emitted points are a flat line at 0.7x the KSVZ coupling (|g_KSVZ| ~ 7.8e-15 GeV^-1 at ~19.9 ueV), giving ~5.5e-15 GeV^-1.
